hints.content: To find the zeros of the function, we need to solve the equation $h(r)=0$. We can do that by factoring $h(r)$.
There are many ways to find the vertex. We will do it by using the fact that the $r$-coordinate of the vertex is exactly between the two zeros.

In conclusion,

$\begin{align}
\text{smaller }r&=-13
\\\\
\text{larger }r&=2
\end{align}$

The vertex of the parabola is at

$\left(-\dfrac{11}{2},-\dfrac{225}{4}\right)$
